claims: Jessie Buckley won the Academy Award for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars for her role as Agnes in the film "Hamnet".
Jessie Buckley is the first Irish actress to win the Academy Award for Best Actress.
Jessie Buckley completed an awards season sweep.
Jessie Buckley accepted the award for her portrayal of a grieving mother in the historical drama "Hamnet".
According to The Guardian, Jessie Buckley spoke emotionally about the accolade, dedicating it to mothers.
The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Rose Byrne was nominated for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars for "If I Had Legs I'd Kick You".
Kate Hudson was nominated for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars for "Song Sung Blue".
Renate Reinsve was nominated for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars for "Sentimental Value".
Emma Stone was nominated for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars for "Bugonia".
